Entries.Text: Son, do you need my help?
That is a military secret.  Why are you asking about it?

Venice has been a economic centre as well as a famous Mediterranean Port since ancient times.

As a judge, what I am most concerned about is security.
Venice has been a famous City since ancient time.
Venice used to be a strong sea power in the Mediterranean.  Did you know that?

Are you joking? I am just a judge, not a philanthropist.

Can you provide some information about Venice?
Can you provide some financial assistance??
Can you provide some equipment assistance?
I want to apply for a Noble Title.
I am the Prince of the Ottoman Empire, and I always seek wisdom for the task of managing the country.  Have you any to offer?

I know there are many bad rumors about him.  However, he is very powerful and respected in the Empire.  He is still needed to control Alexandria.  As you know, he is an old servant of the Empire.  It is hard to punish him for what he has done...
I know quite a bit about his rule in Beirut.  I know how arrogant and ignorant he is.  However, he is the only City Official to collect taxes.  What else can I say?

Ah, the world is changing so fast.  We now know the earth is round, and we have discovered the New World.  The European powers are fighting for their religions.  On the other hand, they are feverishly colonizing the New World and harvesting resources.
Rumors are, after all, only rumors.  We need evidence.  Isn't it childish to judge a person on if you like or hate him?
Because of pirates, we need more battleships to protect our merchant ships.  Besides, expanding the navy needs money, which, of course, comes from taxes.
We need our own navigators and adventurers.  They must be champions who absolutely believe in Allah, and experts in sailing as well.
Alright.  I wish you success.  I swear to Allah that I will not let the leeches of the Empire go free.

If we want to change, it is always necessary to start from the top.  That means it has to start from us, and affect the bureaucrats, step by step.  Meanwhile, we must rebuild relationships with the other countries, and drive away the pirates.  It will take a long time
If you are willing to help us, that is great.  We will highly reward you for any discovery.  Of course, we hope you can start soon.
There is nothing we can do to him?
I will collect evidence of his corruption and support of the pirates.
I want to apply for a Noble Title.

As a judge, what I am most concerned about is security.
Algiers was born as a small commercial outpost of the Phoenicians, and became a Roman trading city.  Empires come and go, but our city remains.
Our city was once a powerful center of commerce in the Mediterranean.
I am not a merchant.  If you need silver coins, you will have to work hard yourself.

Can you provide some financial assistance??
Can you provide some equipment assistance?
I want to apply for a Noble Title.
What can I do for you?
I don't think I could take on the whole government fleet, but I've been known to make my way out of some sticky situations.
It's not always good to be notorious.  Nowadays, all the fleets that come this way are very cautious, and it's become more difficult to plunder their ships.
Don't even think about laying a finger on my booty.  No one who's tried is alive to tell you it doesn't work.
You are still not a Pirate Island member.  Do you want to apply to join us?
Let me have a look at your title.  Hmm....good! you want to raise your title?
Well, I will not force you to join our Pirate Island.
You're the type of bloody bastard I really admire!
Without your guidance, we would already have been destroyed by the government fleet.
Everyone on the sea who hears your name will be terrified.
You have been a pirate for so long a time, so you must have accumulated a lot of treasures...
No, I don't want to apply.
Yes, I want a new title.
No, I want to keep the present title at the moment.

${0:temp_s}Ahoy, Sailor, did you meet with the docker on the Glory?
I'm the master Docker here in ${0:CityName}.  I can sell you provisions and help you hire crewmen.  Are you planning to set sail today?
Quite all right.  I'm the head Docker here in ${0:CityName}.  I can sell you provisions, or even find some men to join your crew.  There's a good wind blowing.  Planning to set sail today?
Welcome, Master ${0:temp_s}.  There's a fair wind blowing today.  Planning to set out to sea?
What do you want to talk about?
As long as you own a ship, have a crew, and bring enough provisions for the voyage, you can ship off anytime.
During the journey, you'll need provisions of food and water.  Even the hardiest sailor can't survive long without provisions.
During navigation and sea battles, you'll need good support from your crew.  You won't be able to sail or fight at sea alone.

When you are at sea, you can only sail one ship at a time.  You can leave your other ships here and we'll will take good care of them.  When you want to sail one of your other ships, come back here and we'll have her ready for you.
I've got a lot of goods to deliver, but not enough hands.  If you have some time to run an errand, I can pay you for your effort.
I haven't got many sailors right now. If you need to hire more, you'll find plenty in the tavern in town.

Please return when you desire more of my knowledge.

Full Speed allows you to activate a temporary increase in sailing speed when your sail is below 60%.  However, if you launch an attack while Full Speed is active, the Full Speed effect will be cancelled.
Pursuit can increase your sailing speed temporarily, but not as much as Full Speed.  You can operate your cannon while Pursuit is active.
Guarding temporarily increases your firepower and lowers hull damage, but it will decrease your sailing speed.
Dodging will help you avoid damage during combat.  Dodging and Block are cannot be active at the same time.
Block temporarily increases your Defense.  Block cannot be used with Bare-handed Fighting or Pistol Firing.  Dodging and Block cannot be active at the same time.
Shocking Strike can temporarily increase your maximum HP and attack power.
Healing helps you recover HP.  This Skill can be used to heal yourself and other players.
Blood Rage will increase your melee power, but your hit rate and HP will decrease.
The Poisoning skill allows you to cure poison.
Cannon Fight is a passive stunt.  It will affect Hit Rate, speed and types of available Cannon available.
Ramming can cause different amounts of damage depending on the type of ram you have equipped.  Ramming damages the Hull Durability of the enemy ship.
Grappling can affect the types of grapples available and their success rate.
This is an active skill.  It inflicts normal damage and causes the enemy to lose their attack accuracy temporarily.
This is a passive skill.  It increases the accuracy of one attack and deals double damage to your enemy.
This is an assistant skill.  It increases your attack power but lowers your attack speed over a period of time.
